meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会成为从 OpenClaw 迁到 NanoClaw v2 的交互式向导。它会先扫描旧安装，读出身份、凭据、频道、定时任务等，再和你逐项商量哪些要迁走；每次改动前先展示方案，不静默复制数据，并维护一份迁移状态文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from openclaw”“openclaw migration”“import from openclaw”这几个词时，Claude 会启动从 OpenClaw 到 NanoClaw v2 的迁移引导。

say.text: 把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2。
say.note: 会先扫描旧安装，给出要迁移内容的摘要。

say.text: 我的 OpenClaw 装在 /srv/old-claw，从那里开始迁移。
say.note: 自定义路径会被交给发现脚本；不写则只查默认位置。

say.text: 先列出旧版里的群和定时任务，我们再决定迁哪些。
say.note: 对应发现后的摘要与讨论。

howto.what_en: An interactive migration guide from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. It scans an existing install, reads identity, credentials, channels, scheduled tasks, then walks you through what to move; writes only after preview.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'migrate from openclaw', 'openclaw migration', or 'import from openclaw'. Claude then starts the migration walkthrough.

say_en.text: Migrate my OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2.
say_en.note: It scans first and summarizes what to bring.

say_en.text: My OpenClaw sits at /srv/old-claw; start from there.
say_en.note: Give your real path; defaults checked otherwise.

say_en.text: First tell me about old groups and scheduled tasks, then decide what to migrate.
